title: Popup save-suggest hides all tag chips when any selected tag's noul is in [0.5, 0.75)
description:
Reported: clicking the extension icon on a page shows the category chip but no tag chips.

ROOT CAUSE (evidence, real extension + Playwright):
- src/decisions/pipeline.ts interpret() 'tags' branch sets the add_tags draft confidence to Math.min over the selected tags of answerConfidence(noul, TAG_THRESHOLD=0.5) = noulMargin(p,0.5) = (p-0.5)/0.5.
- evaluatePolicy (src/decisions/policy.ts) maps add_tags with confidence < REVIEW_FLOOR(0.5) to 'unsure'; persistDraft stores status 'unsure'.
- src/entrypoints/popup/Suggestions.tsx reads listPending() (status 'pending' ONLY), so the row is never rendered.
- ReviewView filters synthetic 'popup:<uuid>' ids, so the row is invisible everywhere.

Consequence: one borderline tag drags the whole draft to 'unsure' and hides every tag, including strong ones.
Measured: noul {rust:0.99, async:0.6} -> row add_tags:unsure:0.20 -> 0 tag chips in the popup (only the category chip). noul {rust:0.8,...} -> add_tags:pending:0.60 -> chips render.
Net user-visible bar is noul >= 0.75 for EVERY selected tag, while RELEASE_THRESHOLDS.tagSelect and store/evals/jev-1.13-baseline.md document the per-tag selection cutoff as 0.50.

Repro: tests/e2e helper routeFakeDecisions with noul={tag_rust:0.99,tag_async:0.6}, seed tags, enable TypeSafe + jev_decisions consent, open popup -> no tag chip.

Fix options: (1) popup reads listReviewable() (pending+unsure) for its synthetic id so every selected tag (noul>=0.50) is offered as an opt-in chip; (2) change the multi-tag confidence aggregation (min -> max); (3) leave semantics and add a 'why nothing' hint. Needed: product call.
acceptance_criteria: Popup renders a tag chip for every tag the model selected at noul >= tagSelect (0.50); a borderline tag never hides a stronger one; auto-apply behaviour unchanged.
notes:
FIXED (option 1: show every selected tag).

Change: src/entrypoints/popup/Suggestions.tsx useSuggestionRows now reads listReviewable() (pending + unsure) instead of listPending(), filtered to the synthetic popup id. The popup is proposal-only, so the review-queue status no longer gates chip visibility; the row's tag list is already the per-tag noul >= 0.50 selection.

Verification:
- Real extension (Playwright, rebuilt): noul {rust:0.99, async:0.6} -> both 'Add suggested tag rust' and 'async' chips render and clicking stages the tag; noul 0.0001 tags render no chip. Before the fix the same case produced 0 tag chips (row was add_tags:unsure:0.20).
- tests/components/popup-suggestions.test.tsx: added a regression case for the unsure-band mixed-tags row; 16/16 pass.
- npx tsc --noEmit clean; eslint clean on changed files; tests/e2e/decisions.spec.ts 'quick-save popup' leg passes.
- Full vitest: 5 pre-existing/flaky failures unrelated to this change (ci-workflow fails on a clean tree after 3337114; decisions-perf / command-palette / sidepanel-actions pass in isolation).

Side effect: an 'unsure' set_category row also renders a chip now (same rule, opt-in, consistent with tags). Auto-apply and the review queue are untouched.

title: audit_hardening_20261001: Audit Hardening
description: Fix all 15 verified audit bugs and named CI, performance, retention, regression, documentation, and browser-verification improvements, with risk-ordered phases and no unrelated backlog.
design:
- Extend existing modules and tests instead of introducing a new state
  framework, provider abstraction, or bookmark store.
- Keep identity-bearing URLs in local matching only. Construct closed,
  minimized outbound summary payloads separately.
- Enforce the output allowance at the existing LLM egress gate and settle
  usage atomically from the durable reservation snapshot.
- Give each background job a single owner through completion of its current
  batch. Resume waits for that owner, then reloads committed progress;
  guarded writes prevent stale owners from changing newer state.
- Use one extension-origin Web Lock for undo stack read/replay/pop/disposal.
  Add a targeted undo primitive that checks its expected snapshot under the
  same lock. No module-local fallback may pretend to provide cross-context
  safety; an unavailable locking surface returns a typed, non-destructive
  refusal.
- Reuse Dexie live reads and existing total message protocols for Options
  state. Credentials remain worker-only.
- Use deterministic bounded near-duplicate planning shared by estimation
  and execution. Persist pair IDs and planning limits, not another raw
  content copy; support existing jobs conservatively.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every B01–B15 bug has a permanent regression that fails against the
  audited behavior and passes with the corresponding fix.
- I01–I08 each has an implementation/verification task and measurable
  evidence, including retention/work bounds and complete scan estimates.
- Undo and JSON round trips preserve summaries alongside tags/category/notes,
  including summary-only rows, remapped IDs, and surviving merge targets.
- Multi-context undo, failed restructure compensation, concurrent creation
  during reconcile, pause/resume with a held request, provider revoke with a
  held response, and Options changes without remount are tested explicitly.
- Blocklisted or mismatched summary inputs produce zero affected provider
  requests; allowed inputs succeed, and serialized payloads contain no
  synthetic query/fragment secret marker.
- Missing usage cannot silently lower a priced request's conservative
  committed spend to zero; late settlement after revoke is idempotent.
- Performance tests prove final-state correctness and bounded work.
  Preserve the existing analyze-on-save worst-of-10 gate below 1.5 s at a
  10k-bookmark corpus; add a 5k+ same-domain planning fixture.
- The final automated gate passes: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`,
  `npm run test -- --run`, `npm run build`, `npm run check:manifest`,
